product.name: Subset AI Spreadsheet Editor
product.description: A desktop and web-based spreadsheet application designed for finance professionals to create, edit, and collaborate on spreadsheets with AI assistance and offline support.

product.name: AI-Powered Chat Editor for Spreadsheets
product.description: An AI-driven chat interface integrated into the spreadsheet editor that allows users to build, edit, and fix spreadsheets through natural language prompts.

product.name: Spreadsheet File Import and Export
product.description: Support for importing and exporting spreadsheet files in XLSX and CSV formats, preserving formatting and formulas.

product.name: Multiplayer Real-Time Collaboration
product.description: A feature that allows multiple users to collaborate on spreadsheets simultaneously with file sharing and workspace management.

product.name: Local-First Desktop Spreadsheet Application
product.description: A desktop spreadsheet app that prioritizes local file access and offline editing with synchronization when online.

product.name: Spreadsheet Templates
product.description: A collection of downloadable spreadsheet templates for financial, personal, and crypto-related calculations and analyses.
